sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The shared lookup-case and selected-factor binding now satisfy the prior repairs, but the derived-pressure tolerance is still not faithful: it uses a fixed 0.000001 floor and scales by an arbitrary expectedValue*0.000001 branch. Replace it with a tolerance strictly scaled from the expected formula result (without a fixed additive/floor tolerance), retaining the two-sided direct comparison averageValue < expectedValue - tolerance or averageValue > expectedValue + tolerance. Preserve the ship target, operands, units, Table 3 reference, lookup evidence, shared case identity, and peakPressureFactor-to-selectedPeakPressureFactor equality.
